title: Terminal numerical-dimension-one abundance in positive characteristic
exact_target: For a normal projective Q-factorial terminal threefold over an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p>3$, if $K_X$ is nef with $\nu (K_X)=1$, must some positive Cartier multiple have at least two independent sections, so that $\kappa (K_X)=1$ and $K_X$ is semiample?
definition_tex:
\subsection{Definitions and mathematical statement}
\paragraph{Statement recorded in the supplied source.}
For a normal projective Q-factorial terminal threefold over an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p>3$, if $K_X$ is nef with $\nu (K_X)=1$, must some positive Cartier multiple have at least two independent sections, so that $\kappa (K_X)=1$ and $K_X$ is semiample?

\subsection{Short English statement}
For a normal projective Q-factorial terminal threefold over an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p>3$, if $K_X$ is nef with $\nu (K_X)=1$, must some positive Cartier multiple have at least two independent sections, so that $\kappa (K_X)=1$ and $K_X$ is semiample?
